headlines.title: Trump says he’ll roll back Biden-era methane rules for oil and gas companies
headlines.description: The EPA plans to ease regulations aimed at curbing methane leaks, Trump said. The potent greenhouse gas is a major contributor to climate change.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.

headlines.title: White House tempers its tough talk on Canada trade as inflation tops voter concerns
headlines.description: Trump’s combative approach to Canada appears to be softening just days before midterm elections in which tariff-fueled inflation is a primary concern for voters.

headlines.title: When to Grab the Best Deals on Everything From Food to Flights
headlines.description: From electronics to clothes, NBC News business and economy reporter Allie Canal joins TODAY to break down when to get the biggest savings.

headlines.title: Rising Diesel Prices Hit School Districts Hard as Midterms Loom
headlines.description: With midterm elections just one week out, rising costs are hitting voters in battleground states across the United States, with the price of diesel fuel going up much quicker than many school districts were prepared to handle, forcing some to alter bus routes and extend wait times. NBC's Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: AI startup Anthropic unveils its public IPO filing for the first time
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveiled its public IPO filing for the first time ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the details surrounding Anthropic ahead of its IPO.

headlines.title: Good vs. Bad Debt: How Borrowing Money Can Help You Grow
headlines.description: Debt might give you anxiety but believe it or not, it can be a good thing if you manage it well. NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down the differences between good and bad debt, list warning signs to lookout for, explain when “buy now, pay later” plans are a good option and share tips to keep your bill under control.

headlines.title: Anthropic reveals $80 billion loss, huge spending spree ahead of IPO
headlines.description: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic unveils its first public IPO filing ahead of what is expected to be one of the largest stock debuts in history.

headlines.title: The Dallas Cowboys cheerleaders are unionizing
headlines.description: America’s highest-profile cheerleading squad has won a victory of its own: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders have formed a union.

headlines.title: Trump administration cancels some Canada tariffs amid close midterm races
headlines.description: Sen. Susan Collins, who’s in a tough re-election fight, said she secured from the Trump administration tariff exemptions on some agricultural and forestry items.

headlines.title: Etsy to restrict AI-generated content in effort to combat seller slop
headlines.description: Etsy announced new restrictions on AI-generated content on its platform, saying it threatens the integrity of sellers’ work and leaves buyers exposed to fraud.

headlines.title: Russian diesel tanker heads to the U.S., the first since Trump’s deal with Putin
headlines.description: A tanker loaded with diesel fuel set sail Friday from Russia for the United States, the first shipment since President Donald Trump agreed to a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to release more fuel into the global market.
